component.name: SafeEyes-RS
component.summary: Protect your eyes from strain with periodic break reminders

description.p: SafeEyes-RS is a lightweight, native Wayland Rust rewrite of SafeEyes for Linux desktops (KDE Plasma and GNOME), built with GTK4 and event-driven system integrations so it uses near-zero CPU and minimal memory while idle.

ul.li: Responsive fullscreen break overlay across all connected monitors via gtk4-layer-shell (with automatic GNOME Mutter fullscreen fallback)
System tray menu with timed disable presets, timer mode switching, manual breaks, and native GTK4 Preferences window
Smart Pause idle detection via Wayland ext-idle-notify-v1 and D-Bus ScreenSaver/login1 integration
Quick Skip, Snooze (postpone break), and Lock Screen actions directly on the break overlay
Optional pre-break desktop notifications and subtle start/end audio chimes

screenshot.caption: Fullscreen break overlay with countdown, Snooze, Skip, and Lock screen actions
System tray menu on KDE Plasma

description.p: Publish downloadable .flatpak bundle directly in GitHub Releases.
Fix StatusNotifierItem system tray registration inside the Flatpak sandbox.
Add Flathub AppStream metadata, vector icon, sandboxed chime audio fallback, and Flatpak manifest.
Add lazy GTK4 Preferences window, keep disabled tray icon visible, and automate multi-distro releases.
Add Snooze (postpone break) action to the break overlay.
